Commentary.Commentary: We are all set for the Super Over to begin. Sherfane Rutherford and Shai Hope walk out to bat for West Indies. Mustafizur Rahman has been handed the ball. Let's go...
... SUPER OVER, FIRST INNINGS ...

Bangladesh will be playing their first-ever Super Over in men's internationals. Pressure will be on both sides, and if you did not know, it will be the West Indies batting first, as the rule is that the chasing side in the regular contest will bat first. The hosts will have to take inspiration from that last over and restrict the Windies to as low as possible, while the visitors will hope to set up a target that they can defend on this tricky wicket. Let's see how things pan out now.

Would you believe it? We are heading to a Super Over in this 2nd ODI, and the players and coaching staff of both sides look absolutely stunned at how we have got here. Nurul Hasan looks dejected after dropping that catch, but credit must go to Saif Hassan for the way he handled pressure in that last over, giving away just four runs. Also, Shai Hope for the way he has batted did not deserve to see his side lose like this, and the Windies have a chance of redemption now.

DROPPED AND WE ARE GOING TO A SUPER OVER! Saif Hassan is down on his haunches in disappointment. Drags the length back, does Saif, on middle. Khary Pierre goes for the slog sweep again but is unable to get under the ball in a fashion he would have liked. Skies it up towards square leg, around the edge of the circle. The keeper, Nurul Hasan calls for it as he sprints to his right and dives in front but fails to cling on. The ball drops on the ground beside him and the converging Mustafizur Rahman tries to pick it up and release the throw but juggles a bit and it is enough for the batters to complete the second run. Incredible scenes in Mirpur. After 100 overs, there is nothing separating the two sides.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Bangladesh get the review right and this is a massive scalp! Drifting in from around the wicket, on the fuller side, on off. Chase reaches out in front and presents a straight bat. Plays the line of the ball and hangs his bat out well in front of his body. The ball lands and spins away before going through to the keeper. Bangladesh go up in unison but the umpire's finger stays down. Mehidy Hasan Miraz takes the review instantly and the UltraEdge shows a spike. The ball has grazed the outside edge on its way to the keeper, Nurul Hasan. A brief stay for Chase. West Indies are now 133/7, needing 81 more runs.
